Previous experience supporting administrative projects/events and direct experience leading, mentoring, or supervising undergraduate students.
Demonstrated experience executing medium- to large-scale events and organizing, collecting, and summarizing program assessment data.
Provide day-to-day guidance, leadership, and supervision to undergraduate student staff and student leaders.
Assist with end-to-end planning, logistics, on-site management, and post-event assessment data collection for campus initiatives.
Manage program records, schedule meetings, prepare agendas/minutes, develop resource materials, and handle electronic file organization.
Partner across UCI Student Housing and campus departments to communicate program goals and ensure successful initiative delivery.
Background working within a college/university setting, Student Affairs, Student Housing, or residential education programs.
Strong skills in Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, Forms) with high organizational capability and confidential data handling.
Familiarity with advanced collaborative workflows in Microsoft SharePoint, OneDrive, and specialized campus administrative systems.
Excellent written/verbal interpersonal skills with the adaptability to reprioritize tasks and work occasional evenings or weekends as event needs require.
Ability to read, write, and follow written and oral instructions in English.
